description: Input-check candidate study on poultry droppings. Threshold: highest score with at most 1% false rejections on the 973 validation images. ood-tune and ood-test from docs/ood/split.json. Test sets were not used to choose the threshold. Written by scripts/gate_study.py.

prompts.description: Text prompts of the input check (zero-shot image-text gate). The in-domain score of a photo is the softmax mass on the in_domain prompts, with the softmax taken over all prompts. The first 8 in_domain prompts and all reject prompts were written from the task's list of photos that must pass and must be rejected, before any score was computed. The last 6 in_domain prompts were added after looking at the lowest-scoring validation images (yellow caecal droppings, blurred photos, droppings on tarpaulin or concrete) and comparing both lists on the tuning sets only (validation images and ood-tune); the test sets were not consulted.
in_domain: a close-up photo of chicken droppings
a photo of chicken droppings on the floor
a photo of chicken feces on poultry litter
a photo of poultry droppings on the ground
a close-up photo of bloody chicken droppings
a close-up photo of watery chicken droppings
a close-up photo of green chicken droppings
a close-up photo of brown chicken droppings
a close-up photo of yellow pasty chicken droppings
a blurry close-up photo of chicken droppings on the ground
a photo of chicken droppings with white urates
a photo of chicken droppings on a concrete floor
a photo of runny chicken droppings on a farm floor
a close-up photo of chicken droppings on a blue tarpaulin
reject: a photo of a bowl of porridge
a photo of food on a plate
a photo of an egg tray
a photo of a concrete floor
